catalogue.name: Skirmishes
catalogue.readme:
Force Generation:
Decide on a number of points (p), max restricted weapons (R), advancements (A), Faction Powers (FP) and Themed Skrimish Faction Descriptors (D).

Example force generations

» Bottom of the barrel: 35p (no weapons above 0.5p).

» A simple band of miscreants: 50p, max 2 restricted weapons.

» Experienced gangers ready to rumble: 60p and 5 advancements, no more than 2 on the same model. Max 2 restricted weapons.

» Themed gangers united: 60p and 3 advancements, no more than 1 on the same model. 2 Themed Skrimish Faction Descriptors (advancements from descriptors may be put on models with advancements). 3 Faction Power points.

Cost Types:
FP: Faction Powers points
p: Points
R: Restriced Access
A: Advancement Points
D: Themed Skrimish Faction Descriptors

Disregard cost type U, it is not used in Skirmishes.

sharedRules.name: Smoke grenade
sharedRules.description: Place centre of smoke cloud (5” diameter circle) anywhere within range. Targets of attacks into/out of/through have target(potshots) until end of turn and Concealment until end of next turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Combat Armour
sharedRules.description: Defence(5)

sharedRules.name: Autostimmer
sharedRules.description: auto-triage with +1 at end of turn if downed, one use. Triage effects do not stack

sharedRules.name: Enviro-compensator
sharedRules.description: Ignore(d by) battlefield conditions. Represents gas masks, rat repellent, etc.

sharedRules.name: Medkit
sharedRules.description: +1 on triage actions. Triage effects do not stack

sharedRules.name: Stimpack
sharedRules.description: +2 to triage action, one use. Triage effects do not stack

sharedRules.name: Cyber-prosthetic
sharedRules.description: Ignore the effects of 1 trauma.

sharedRules.name: Clip-harness
sharedRules.description: Free vertical downward movement (max 18”).

sharedRules.name: Breaching Charge
sharedRules.description: Instead of attack, create 1” breach in adjacent wall no thicker than 0.5” and attack targets behind the breach with 6” (1), blast(half), one use.

sharedRules.name: Bike, heavy
sharedRules.description: Move(9, no climb), Capacity(1, open), Cover(max 1), Cargo(no)

sharedRules.name: Bike, light
sharedRules.description: Move(12, no climb), Cover(max 1), Cargo(no)

sharedRules.name: Enclosed Armour
sharedRules.description: Defence(6).

sharedRules.name: Climber
sharedRules.description: Model may take one (1) free vertical move with any move action.

sharedRules.name: Leaper
sharedRules.description: Model rolls +1 dice when leaping (pick highest).

sharedRules.name: Dash
sharedRules.description: This model has Target(+1) vs reaction attacks when making a Double Move.

sharedRules.name: Move(+1)
sharedRules.description: Model moves +1" with each move.

sharedRules.name: Lurker
sharedRules.description: No movement penalty from ducking.

sharedRules.name: Shield Other(3”)
sharedRules.description: Hits vs closest regular target within 3” may be redirected to this model.

sharedRules.name: Ablative Armour
sharedRules.description: model has 1 additional Defence(3) wound. This does not count towards unit size.

sharedRules.name: Resilient
sharedRules.description: This model can re-roll the result on the Injury table.

sharedRules.name: Shake it off(4+)
sharedRules.description: Roll when downed; on 4+ model receives 2 action markers instead.

sharedRules.name: Sharpshooter
sharedRules.description: priority(hit(re-roll)) with marksman weapons.

sharedRules.name: Gunslinger
sharedRules.description: First Strike with pistol weapons.

sharedRules.name: Deadeye Shot
sharedRules.description: [Sharpshooter OR Gunslinger]: priority(vital strike) with marksman weapons and vital strike with pistol weapons.

sharedRules.name: Secondary target
sharedRules.description: You may re-roll missed attacks versus another target along the same line of fire.

sharedRules.name: Stretcher Bearers
sharedRules.description: Model may evacuate without going into staging.

sharedRules.name: Armourer
sharedRules.description: 1 restricted weapon or 2 non-restricted weapons in force gets Masterwork.

sharedRules.name: Restricted Access
sharedRules.description: model may use restricted weapons (in addition to any otherwise allowed).

sharedRules.name: Packing expert
sharedRules.description: Model has 4 extra consumables slots and 1 extra hand slot that cannot be used for weapons.

sharedRules.name: Breacher
sharedRules.description: Wound(re-roll) vs structures within 2”. Using one-use breaching equipment gear replaces a move instead of an attack.

sharedRules.name: Equipment Mule
sharedRules.description: Friendly models within 12” may use items with one use carried by this model.

sharedRules.name: Savers Keepers
sharedRules.description: This model’s one use items can be used 1 extra time. one use(x2) becomes (x3).

sharedRules.name: Mystic Familiar
sharedRules.description: Model may boost a mystic power without rolling doubles once per game.

sharedRules.name: Mindscourge
sharedRules.description: Model’s mystic power attacks have indirect(-2). If attacking another Mystic, indirect(no penalty) and hazardous instead.

sharedRules.name: Formidable Frame
sharedRules.description: Model is not encumbered by a single heavy load OR non-priority attacks with heavy weapons are inaccurate instead of potshots.

sharedRules.name: Return to Sender
sharedRules.description: Use if a model is attacked with or the effect of a thrown grenade is placed within 6”. On 3+ this model may use an identical grenade instead.

sharedRules.name: True Grit
sharedRules.description: Instead of becoming downed, you may no longer remove the model’s last action marker. If it receives another wound, it is downed normally.

sharedRules.name: Taunt
sharedRules.description: Instead of attacking, model may taunt until end of turn: it becomes exposed, but attacks versus targets that are not taunting that could target a taunting model become inaccurate.

sharedRules.name: Functional Bravado
sharedRules.description: Model may ignore first ranged hit each turn if in open terrain.

sharedRules.name: Volg-style shooter
sharedRules.description: If ducking this model may attack as if not ducking. Such attacks are potshots.

sharedRules.name: Backstab
sharedRules.description: Hit(+1) and vital strike with CC attacks when charging if target has other enemies within 2”, or if target is exposed.

sharedRules.name: Hidden Weapon
sharedRules.description: Attack the first enemy each turn that charges this model with (1) before executing the attack.

sharedRules.name: Master of Mischief
sharedRules.description: Enemy models within 12” that have exactly two (2) action markers in endphase may only remove one (1) automatically.

sharedRules.name: Extra arm
sharedRules.description: Model has 1 extra hand slot, which can also be used for attacks.

sharedRules.name: Elongated Legs
sharedRules.description: Model may count as 3” taller when making attacks, can cross impassable terrain of max 3” height/width, and make a free 3” vertical move once per turn.

sharedRules.name: Scarred Veteran
sharedRules.description: Model may ignore the effects of 1 trauma.

sharedRules.name: Intel and Lore
sharedRules.description: Know things about what you encounter or will encounter, such as other groups and characters, strengths and weaknesses of the enemy, dangerous (or not so) plants and wildlife, etc.

sharedRules.name: Influence and Deception
sharedRules.description: Influence, intimidate, cajole, interrogate, bluff, and “read” others. This includes such useful things as begging for reinforcements or extraction from higher echelon command!

sharedRules.name: Perception and Investigation
sharedRules.description: Spot lurkers, ambushers, hidden guards etc., and find items or clues. Use it to spot changing circumstances, identify terrain and avoid traps.

sharedRules.name: Technology and Larceny
sharedRules.description: Craft, hack, lockpick, hotwire, sabotage, etc. Arm and disarm traps, alarms and the like.

sharedRules.name: Stealth and Sleight
sharedRules.description: Sneak, hide, sleight of hand and other malarkey before stuff kicks off. Create blinds, stash loot for later pickup and plant bugs.

sharedRules.name: Smoke Launcher
sharedRules.description: As smoke grenade with 9/18” range, one use.

sharedRules.name: Chemical Smoke
sharedRules.description: As smoke grenade, but blocks line of sight until 1st endphase, potshots until 2nd, etc. Smoke-ignoring sights/abilities reduce the effects one step.

sharedRules.name: Willy Pete smoke
sharedRules.description: As smoke grenade, also hazardous terrain for non-vehicle/massive units until 1P 1st endphase.

sharedRules.name: Poison/Knockout Gas grenade
sharedRules.description: Deploy as smoke grenade. Gas cloud is hazardous terrain for non-vehicle/massive. Disperses at end of turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Irritant Gas grenade
sharedRules.description: Deploy as smoke grenade. Non-vehicle/massive models in cloud may not remove last activation marker. Disperses at end of turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Blacksight
sharedRules.description: Ignore smoke, concealment, camouflage and hidden. Upgrade any ranged weapon.

sharedRules.name: Bipod
sharedRules.description: Marksman weapon or LMG becomes heavy. Upgrade any ranged weapon.

sharedRules.name: Underslung Weapon
sharedRules.description:
As any 5p-weapon without one use. One use. 
Every two (2) underslung weapons in your force counts as a restricted weapon

sharedRules.name: Assault ladder
sharedRules.description:
Emplace in base contact as part of move. Models may use emplaced ladder to climb up to one floor (roughly 3”) without penalty.
heavy: carrier counts as encumbered unless carried by two models, may climb two floors without penalty.

sharedRules.name: Climbing gear
sharedRules.description: Model may climb normally inaccessible surfaces, such as sheer walls.

sharedRules.name: Communications
sharedRules.description: Leader trait of model with within 2” has unlimited range.

sharedRules.name: Crude Enclosed Armour
sharedRules.description: Defence(+2), Move(-1).

sharedRules.name: Cyborg Conversion
sharedRules.description: Roll on vehicle damage table for model when suffering last wound instead of removing as casualty. Triage is not possible on this model.

sharedRules.name: Grav-mounted weapon
sharedRules.description: Weapon loses the heavy trait.

sharedRules.name: Illumination Launcher
sharedRules.description: Deploy within 18” on 2+ instead of attack. Models within 6” lose Hidden, Concealment and Camouflage, has inaccurate and do not benefit from low visibility until end of next turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Medical drone
sharedRules.description: User may perform triage on models up to 12” away.

sharedRules.name: Zipline Launcher
sharedRules.description: Emplace between base contact and point within 18” instead of attack. 1 model/turn within 2” may move from higher to lower point with two (2) moves, or climb from lower to higher as difficult terrain. One use.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: Blade poison
sharedRules.description:
Model’s CC attacks get wound(re-roll). One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: Rush
sharedRules.description:
Model gets Move(+1). One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: Yayo snuff
sharedRules.description:
Tough(5) and inaccurate. One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: Go-Pills
sharedRules.description:
Use in endphase. Model removes 1 additional action marker. One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: Celeritas
sharedRules.description:
Model gets target(5). One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Drugs: CatEyes
sharedRules.description:
Model ignores concealment, and gets inaccurate instead from smoke, Camouflage and Hidden. One use(x2).
Use (max 1 drug) when activating. lasts until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Up
sharedRules.description:
Up: Mystic(+1) for one roll. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Boozt
sharedRules.description:
Boozt: mystic takes hit, power is boosted. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Strech
sharedRules.description:
Stretch: range for mystic power is increased 6”. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Lazt
sharedRules.description:
Lazt: sustain mystic power for free this turn. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Down
sharedRules.description:
Down: mystic takes hit on 4+ instead of regular ’1’ result. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Drugs Aztral
sharedRules.description:
Aztral: mystic power gets indirect. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when needed.

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: AP
sharedRules.description:
Wound(+1) vs Defence(5) or better.
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: Less-than-lethal
sharedRules.description:
If this attack causes a wound, suppression(x2) instead. For restricted weapons the cost is 1p for one use.
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: Incendiary
sharedRules.description:
Ignore cover(1).
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: HE
sharedRules.description:
Wound(+1) vs Defence(4) or worse.
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: Match Grade Ammunition
sharedRules.description:
Weapon with range 24” or more gets range +6”.
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Special Ammo: Agonizers
sharedRules.description:
No Triage is possible for models downed by this weapon.
Use (max 1 per model) before ranged attack, one use(x2).

sharedRules.name: Deployable Explosive AP
sharedRules.description:
AP: attack with 3” (1), blast(D6). 
Emplace in base contact instead of attack. May later be detonated instead of attack if within 12” of user. One use.

sharedRules.name: Deployable Explosive AT
sharedRules.description:
AT: vehicle or massive model within 3” suffers wound(+4) hit vs weak armour.
Emplace in base contact instead of attack. May later be detonated instead of attack if within 12” of user. One use.

sharedRules.name: Deployable Explosive AP, Proximity sensor
sharedRules.description:
AP: attack with 3” (1), blast(D6). 
Emplace in base contact instead of attack. Proximity sensor: attacks first unit within 3” automatically (after emplacing unit has left). One use.

sharedRules.name: Deployable Explosive AT, Proximity sensor
sharedRules.description:
AT: vehicle or massive model within 3” suffers wound(+4) hit vs weak armour.
Emplace in base contact instead of attack. Proximity sensor: attacks first unit within 3” automatically (after emplacing unit has left). One use.

sharedRules.name: Additional Ammo
sharedRules.description: Replenishes a weapon once (only if using ammo option).

sharedRules.name: Concealable/Collapsible Weapon
sharedRules.description: Weapon can be concealed from scanners and searches (non-restricted weapons can be drawn and used immediately, restricted weapons require a moment of discreet assembly)

sharedRules.name: Silencer
sharedRules.description: Attack with weapon does not raise alarm (when applicable, not for restricted weapons).

sharedRules.name: Currency
sharedRules.description: A few substantial units of local currency, used for bribes and services during missions. (The exact effect is entirely up to the GM).

sharedRules.name: Deployable Raft
sharedRules.description: Counts as heavy load until deployment. Deploy as full action. Up to four human-sized models may use it to cross water obstacles.

sharedRules.name: Flexible Assets
sharedRules.description: X points that can be converted into whatever the character needs before every mission. (May only be bought with “permanent” points, and renew each game).

sharedRules.name: Heat Camera
sharedRules.description: Model can see heat sources, possibly spotting hidden units/areas of activity/active machinery and the like.

sharedRules.name: Intrusion Drone
sharedRules.description: User may perform Technology/Larceny actions up to 12” away.

sharedRules.name: Loudhailer
sharedRules.description: Allows model to communicate at a distance (up to 18”), and address crowds, besieged individuals and the like. Extends Leader ability to 18”.

sharedRules.name: Opto-Snakedrill
sharedRules.description: Use instead of attack: allows clandestinely looking through doors and cracks.

sharedRules.name: Tacdrone, Mini
sharedRules.description: Deploy within 24” on 2+ as full action. Model may view as if at this spot until end of turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs PheroDate
sharedRules.description:
PheroDate: Influence/Deception(+1). Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs SharpSense
sharedRules.description:
SharpSense: Perception/Investigation(+1). Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs SaphJuice
sharedRules.description:
SaphJuice: player may ask GM one (1) yes/no question. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs Coldheart
sharedRules.description:
Coldheart: User is not picked up by proximity sensors, motion detectors, heatscopes and the like. Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs ReCall
sharedRules.description:
ReCall: Intel/Lore(+1). Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Operator Drugs AuxProc
sharedRules.description:
AuxProc: Technology/Larceny(+1). Two use, max 1 use/turn/model.
Unless otherwise specified, these drugs may be used when activated and lasts until the end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Tools, Specialised
sharedRules.description:
Specialized tools give a +1 dice bonus to one specific usage of a skill 
- examples include:
Lock Spike: Larceny to pick lock
Forged Documents: Deception to pass checkpoint 
Ghillie suit: Stealth in specific terrain piece

sharedRules.name: Services
sharedRules.description: Services are usually paid for with temporary liquid assets and the like and last for one game/once only.

sharedRules.name: Subordinate
sharedRules.description: Model does not remove action markers automatically unless a non-subordinate friendly model within 12” with less than two (2) markers takes one (1) action marker in the endphase.

sharedRules.name: Nerves(x)
sharedRules.description: Return unit to staging if it has X action markers remaining in endphase (after removal).

sharedRules.name: Nerves(3)
sharedRules.description: Return unit to staging if it has 3 action markers remaining in endphase (after removal).

sharedRules.name: Special Care
sharedRules.description: One re-roll on the lasting injury table.

sharedRules.name: Interrogation Specialist
sharedRules.description: Converts prisoners into minor clues on 5+.

sharedRules.name: Cheap Weapons
sharedRules.description: Two (2) <0.5p weapons

sharedRules.name: Fence
sharedRules.description: Converts loot into temporary liquid assets, GM decides worth.

sharedRules.name: Scrapsmith
sharedRules.description: Restore function of previously exhausted item on 4+ (if fail or exhausted again, it is gone forever).

sharedRules.name: Local Informant
sharedRules.description: Lore/Intel(+1) for any pre-mission roll.

sharedRules.name: Suppressive fire
sharedRules.description: When making a ranged attack with exactly 2 dice, you may take Attack(+1) and wound(no).

sharedRules.name: Accurate(ranged)
sharedRules.description: Range attacks with this model has hit(+1). Multiple sources of Accurate does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Non-threatening
sharedRules.description: Model has concealment vs attackers that have other regular enemies within range and los.

sharedRules.name: Inflict Disruption (12”)
sharedRules.description: Enemy models within range has disruption: Models22222222222222222222222222222222222222222222 may not remove extra action markers in endphase. If a model already has trait at a worse level, this takes precedence.

sharedRules.name: Five Foot step
sharedRules.description: Model may make a 3” move when taking the attack and priority attack actions.

sharedRules.name: Startling Lunge
sharedRules.description: Model has Target(+1) when making a CC attack vs ranged attack from target.

sharedRules.name: Fury of the kill
sharedRules.description: Make a 6” move after an enemy unit within 2” makes a withdrawal move or is downed by this model’s CC attack.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Techno
sharedRules.description:
Tinkerers: spend 1 FP before game to give one (1) weapon Masterwork until end of game.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Gearhead or shooting categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Mutant
sharedRules.description:
Under the skin: spend 1 FP to give 1 model CC (2) until end of turn.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Mutations/Enhancements or Close Combat categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Aristo
sharedRules.description:
Best care money can buy: spend 1 FP to re-roll any Triage roll.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Heroism/Madness or support categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Cultist
sharedRules.description:
Doubt: spend 1 FP when an enemy unit enters the battlefield to give it 1 action marker.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Mystic or Mutations/Enhancements categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Lawbringer
sharedRules.description:
“legitimacy”: spend 1 FP: one (1) enemy downed model within 6” of a friendly model cannot receive triage.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Gearhead or tank categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Cyborg
sharedRules.description:
Enhanced: spend 1 FP to roll on the triage table with +1 for any downed friendly model.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Mutations/Enhancements or tank categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Shadow
sharedRules.description:
Hidden ways: spend 1 FP to give a friendly model in staging Outflank(18”). It may not leave staging this turn.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the stealth or Movement categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Chemist
sharedRules.description:
Uppers: spend 1 FP to discard 1 extra action marker in the endphase.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Cunning or Gearhead categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Classic
sharedRules.description:
Focused: this faction has +1FP.
One (1) model receives an advancement from any category.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Feral
sharedRules.description:
Born in it, molded by it: spend 1 or more FP to shift the result of the battlefield condition roll 1 step each up or down.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Cunning or stealth categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Pureblood
sharedRules.description:
Purists: models of this faction have Loathing vs all factions except Classic Pureblood.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the shooting or stealth categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Prole
sharedRules.description:
Strike when the iron is hot: spend 1 FP to Snatch the Initiative (see p19), but you may make two (2) activations.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the tank or support categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Zealot
sharedRules.description:
Conviction: spend 1 FP to give one (1) model Charge(frenzied) until end of turn.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Heroism/Madness or Close Combat categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Outlaw
sharedRules.description:
Hey Peppin!: spend 1 FP to allow one (1) model to trace LOS freely even if ducking for one (1) attack.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the shooting or Cunning categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Alien
sharedRules.description:
Twitch: spend 1 FP to make one (1) attack with a friendly downed model. May only be used by models that do not require evacuation. After use, model requires evacuation (and triage is no longer possible).
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Mystic or Close Combat categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Showboat
sharedRules.description:
On stage: spend 1 FP to discard all action markers from suppression from 1 attack vs a unit not in cover.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Heroism/Madness or Movement categories.

sharedRules.name: Faction: Teetotallers
sharedRules.description:
Disciplined: spend 1 FP to discard 1 action marker from suppression when it is received.
One (1) model receives an advancement from either the Movement or support categories.

sharedRules.name: Corpus Conversion
sharedRules.description: Model rolls on vehicle damage table instead of being downed. No Triage is possible on this model.

sharedRules.name: Rivalry Faction: Cyborg
sharedRules.description: Faction have loathing towards Cyborg factions.

sharedRules.name: Advancements
sharedRules.description: Any advancements should come from max two (2) advancement schemes besides common per model.

sharedRules.name: Mystic(Trained)
sharedRules.description:
1	Nosebleed: the mystic takes 1 hit
	Boosted: the mystic is downed and requires evacuation. Closest enemy regular unit suffers D3 hits.

2-3+	Mind Bullets: attack with 18” (3) 
	Boosted: 24” (4)

4+ 	Encourage Effort: Bestow Masterwork (12”) until end of turn.
	Boosted: 18”

5+ 	Force Lift: 12” (1 friendly regular model in los): move up to 12”, ignoring terrain.
	Boosted: within 18”, up to 15”

6+	Turn Enemy: 18” (1 enemy unit in los): forced to make an immediate withdrawal move
	Boosted: 24”, 2 withdrawal moves

*used instead of attacking

sharedRules.name: Mystic(Wild)
sharedRules.description:
1	Madness: roll again, opponent choses target (ignore rolls of ‘1’).
	Boosted: replace the mystic’s traits with: Wounds(3), Defence(5), Tough(6), Scoring(no), CC (D6) and under the command of your opponent.

2-3+	Pyroclastic Assault: attack with 18” (3), savage strike
	Boosted: 24” (4)

4+ 	Kinetic Slam: 18” (1 unit in los): move D6” straight from the mystic. If it impacts blocking terrain it stops and gets 1 action marker.
	Boosted: two (2) units

5+ 	Overwhelm: attack with 18” (4), wound(no), suppression(x2)
	Boosted: 24” (6)

6+	Flamestorm: 18” (1), spray, ignore cover(1), tight spread
	Boosted: 24”, ignore cover

*used instead of attacking

sharedRules.name: Seasoned
sharedRules.description: Model has 1 additional Wound. This does not count towards unit size.

sharedRules.description: Model has 1 additional Wound. This does not count towards unit size.

sharedRules.name: Wound restrictions
sharedRules.description:
The extra wounds trait in the common category is further restricted; up to half (round down) of your models can have 1 extra wound, and up to half (round down) of those can have 2 extra wounds. e.g. in a tacteam of four models you can max have one model with 3 wounds and one with 2 wounds.
This does not include traits such as Ablative Armour.

sharedRules.name: Non-combatant
sharedRules.description: If this model is armed only with pistol weapons and has never attacked this game, it may only be attacked if it is the closest target.

sharedRules.name: Selfless Assistance
sharedRules.description: When a friendly model within 6” receives an action marker from suppression, you may transfer it to this model instead as long as it has max 2 action markers.

sharedRules.name: Assault ladder, heavy
sharedRules.description: Emplace in base contact as part of move. Models may use emplaced ladder to climb up to two floors(roughly 6”) without penalty. Carrier counts as encumbered unless carried by two models.

sharedRules.name: Steed
sharedRules.description: Move(9, nimble, no climb, may leap), Cover(max 1), Cargo(no)

sharedRules.name: Flak Jacket
sharedRules.description: Defence(5) vs weapons with the blast trait.

sharedRules.name: Bangalore
sharedRules.description: Instead of attack create 2x6” path through (most) difficult or dangerous terrain, one use.

sharedRules.name: Quickdraw holster
sharedRules.description: Model has 1 extra hand slot.

sharedRules.name: Combat Webbing
sharedRules.description: Model has 2 extra inventory slots.

sharedRules.name: Large bag
sharedRules.description: Model has 6 extra inventory slots.

sharedRules.name: “Pavise” mobile cover
sharedRules.description: Model counts as encumbered when moving the Pavise. It may be emplaced as part of a move, and provides Cover(2) for up to two (2) adjacent models from attacks from in front of the pavise.

sharedRules.name: Encumbered
sharedRules.description: Models carrying a heavy load (such as loot or a fallen comrade) have their movement reduced by a third.

sharedRules.name: Buckler shield
sharedRules.description: Model has parry. If it already has, it gets Target(re-roll) vs CC instead.

sharedRules.name: Rope
sharedRules.description: Lower as part of move to allow other models to climb (as difficult terrain) where you normally couldn’t (max 18”). One use.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Lucky amulet
sharedRules.description: Re-roll a single dice of a roll made by this model, one use.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Protective charm
sharedRules.description: Force re-roll of single wound roll dice vs this model, this re-roll receives no bonuses to Defence. One use.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Faction symbol
sharedRules.description: This model receives no wounds for proximity to enemy models in the endphase, one use.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Seal of purity
sharedRules.description: Ignore one (1) hit that did not wound vs this model, one use.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Cursed Icon
sharedRules.description: Model has hazardous target until the trait has caused 1 hit.

sharedRules.name: Trinket: Mystic focus
sharedRules.description: Roll one (1) extra dice when using Mystic, one use.

sharedRules.name: Reach
sharedRules.description: Weapon has range +1”. Upgrade any close combat weapon.

sharedRules.name: Great
sharedRules.description: Weapon has an additional wound(+1). Upgrade any hands(1) close combat weapon.

sharedRules.name: Masterwork
sharedRules.description: Re-roll results of ‘1’ to hit for this model. Upgrade any close combat or ranged weapon.

sharedRules.name: One free hand
sharedRules.description: One (1) free hand slot can be converted to two (2) extra inventory slots.

sharedRules.name: Loadout Limits
sharedRules.description: A regular model has 2 hand slots and 4 inventory slots to carry weapons and/or equipment. Encumbrance is listed either for a category or with hands/inventory (note that many items have no encumbrance).

sharedRules.name: Wielding multiple weapons
sharedRules.description: A model can attack with a single weapon only. If wielding more than one (1) identical weapon (up to two (2) hands worth), add one (1) attack dice for each additional weapon.

sharedRules.name: Vantage vulture
sharedRules.description: This model has Ignore Cover(1) vs units on a lower elevation.

sharedRules.name: Point Blank specialist
sharedRules.description: Attacks from this model with unrestricted/non- consumable weapons have the Pistol trait if within 6” of the target.

sharedRules.name: You go low, I go high
sharedRules.description: You may share space with friendly non-vehicle/ massive model in base contact.

sharedRules.name: Savage
sharedRules.description: CC attacks from this model has Savage Strike.

sharedRules.name: Friendlier Fire
sharedRules.description: Friendly models ignore you when attacking enemy models within 2”.

sharedRules.name: Blind Strike
sharedRules.description: Model may react with CC attacks even without LOS.

sharedRules.name: Diggy Diggy Hole
sharedRules.description: Model may spend two (2) moves to give itself Cover(+1, max 2) until it moves.

sharedRules.name: Stack Up and Move Out!
sharedRules.description: Up to three (3) friendly non-vehicle/massive models in consecutive base contact may measure their movement from your position.

sharedRules.name: Dynamic Entry
sharedRules.description: Model has Insertion(unreliable).

sharedRules.name: Shield expert
sharedRules.description: Hits that were not re-rolled with Combat Shield do not cause suppression.

sharedRules.name: Diehard
sharedRules.description: Model may crawl 3” each endphase if downed and may evacuate itself.

sharedRules.name: Hardened Armour
sharedRules.description: Wound(+1) attacks against this model counts as wound(+0).

sharedRules.name: Supervisor
sharedRules.description: You do not receive an action marker for removing action markers from up to two (2) Subordinate models each endphase.

sharedRules.name: Henchperson/Pet
sharedRules.description: Add 1x Henchperson: Subordinate, Pistol OR Pet: Subordinate, Move(9, no climb), CC (2) to your force.

sharedRules.name: Triage master
sharedRules.description: Roll two (2) dice when performing Triage, keep the best result.

sharedRules.name: Ground hugger
sharedRules.description: Model has Defence(+1 in cover).

sharedRules.name: Flanker
sharedRules.description: Model has Outflank(18”).

sharedRules.name: Low profile
sharedRules.description: Model has Camouflage(18”)

sharedRules.name: Sticky Fingers
sharedRules.description: This model may use consumables from friendly models within 12”.

sharedRules.name: Lucky(1)
sharedRules.description: +1 FP that may only be used by this model.

sharedRules.name: Cuisine Vitamine
sharedRules.description: Model may gain the effects of any combat or operator drug on 2+ once/turn. On a roll of ‘1’, it takes a hit instead.

sharedRules.name: Adapted
sharedRules.description: Model is immune to (most) Battlefield Conditions.

sharedRules.name: Horrible Visage
sharedRules.description: Model has Terror(6”).

sharedRules.name: Bounding Leap
sharedRules.description: This model has Move(jump).

sharedRules.name: Inspiring
sharedRules.description: Models revived through triage by this model receive only one (1) action marker.

sharedRules.name: Inspiring last words
sharedRules.description: +2 FP when this model needs evacuation.

sharedRules.name: Preacher
sharedRules.description: Bestow Loathing (12”, closest two (2) models only).

sharedRules.name: Hurler
sharedRules.description: Increase thrown grenade ranges 3”.

sharedRules.name: Loader
sharedRules.description: Model may attach to other model with LMG or HMG, and give that weapon +1 attack dice instead of own attack if within 3”.

sharedRules.name: Hello there farmer
sharedRules.description: You carry 1p of backup weapon(s) that you may give to allies/subordinates encountered during a mission.

sharedRules.name: Jack of All Trades
sharedRules.description: Single (1) dice on three (3) skills.

sharedRules.name: Double Shifter
sharedRules.description: This model may take an extra downtime action.

sharedRules.name: Skill Expert
sharedRules.description: Specific skill(+1).

sharedRules.name: Mystic Sense
sharedRules.description: Enemies may not deploy with Insertion or Ambush within 15” of this model. If used in a narrative, the GM might allow rolls to get “strange insights” and “sense disturbances”.

sharedRules.name: Propelled by Power
sharedRules.description: This model has Move(hover, max 2” high obstacles).

sharedRules.name: Disciplined Mind
sharedRules.description: May sustain 1 power for free.
